items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author labelled lemma at source lines 456-458 (book Theorem 6.4.2): there is an element of the family of self-paths of the circle which is not the family sending every point to reflexivity. The statement asserts an existence and a disequality, and the proof (source lines 459-468) builds the witness: it defines a dependent function by circle induction, which forces it to produce the dependent path required at the generating loop, computes that transport through the loop family as a concatenation identity, and discharges it by cancelling an inverse; the disequality is then obtained by evaluating both families at the base point, where it reduces to the previously established non-triviality of the generating loop. The transport computation at the path constructor is the substance and it is invisible in the statement.
